listing.description: A website for a furniture store or home textiles salon: collection spreads with sizes and lead times, a fabric palette, sewing rates and an order form sent to Telegram.

seo.title: Your Company — furniture and home textiles in Tashkent
seo.description: Sofas, beds, throws and curtains in warm tones. Showroom on Muqimiy St, delivery across Tashkent in 2 days, made-to-measure curtains from 7 days.
seo.answer: Your Company is a furniture and home textiles store in Tashkent (7 Muqimiy St), open daily 10:00–20:00. Sofas from 6,900,000 UZS, beds from 4,800,000 UZS, made-to-measure curtains from 7 days. Delivery across Tashkent takes 2 days, carrying and assembly included.

sections.title: A home you want to stay in
sections.eyebrow: Furniture & textiles · Tashkent · showroom on Muqimiy
sections.subtitle: Soft sofas, beds with linen headboards, wool throws and curtains made to your measurements. Touch everything in the showroom and have it at home in two days.

sections.label: About
sections.title: Things that grow warmer with time
sections.text: We choose furniture you will not want to replace in two years: beech and birch frames, fillings that do not sag, durable fabrics. Curtains, bedspreads and covers are sewn in our own workshop in the same building, so the sofa and curtain colours match exactly. The showroom designer will put together a room from our pieces for free.
